51603955.protein: NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3
51603955.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to streptavidin sensor chip-immobilized biotinylated recombinant human NLRP3 NACHT domain extracted from Sf9 insect cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: SPR experiments were performed using a Biacore 8 K instrument (GE Healthcare) operated at 25 °C and flushed with running buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 200 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM ADP, 0.5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (TCEP), 2 mM MgCl2, 1 g/L carboxymethyl dextran hydrogel (CMD), 0.05 % Tween20, 2 % DMSO). Biotinylated NLRP3NACHT protein was expressed in Sf9 insect cells and after purification immobilized on a streptavidin sensor chip (Cytiva). After equilibration for 2 h, different concentrations of test compounds were injected in single-cycle kinetics mode (30 μL/min, association phase 240 s, dissociation phase 60 / 360 s). Data were collected at a rate of 10 Hz. The binding data were double referenced by blank cycle and reference flow cell subtraction. Data were corrected by a 4-point solvent correction. Processed data were fitted to a 1:1 interaction model using the Biacore Insight Evaluation Software (version 3.0.12.15655).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Compound 3 (BAL-0028) binds to the NLRP3 NACHT domain with high affinity.
